t: 钱德拉古普塔 我正式加冕为第一位古塔皇帝.
te: Chandragupta I is officially crowned as the first Gupta Emperor.
dz: 钱德拉古普塔 我正式加冕为第一位古塔皇帝.
de: Chandragupta I is officially crowned as the first Gupta Emperor.
